rules: Headings MUST use IBM Plex Sans, ensuring a stark, high-tech command center feel.
All data points, numbers, JSON output, URLs, and risk scores MUST use JetBrains Mono for legibility and technical aesthetic.
Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for large headers.
Overlines/Labels (e.g., 'RISK LEVEL', 'VERDICT') MUST be uppercase, text-xs or text-sm, and tracking-[0.2em] with muted colors.
NEVER use generic gradients. Use flat dark backgrounds with glowing accent borders or subtle inner shadows.
Apply risk colors prominently: text, icon colors, border glow, or progress gauge fills.
Tint greys towards deep blue (Navy) rather than neutral black.

structure: Left Column (Input/Controls): col-span-12 lg:col-span-4. Should be sticky if possible.
Stats Row: 4 cards, each col-span-12 sm:col-span-6 md:col-span-3.
Indicators & URLs: Two columns inside the right panel (col-span-6 each).
spacing: Use generous internal padding for cards: p-6 or p-8.
Maintain a cohesive gap-6 between grid items.
Cards must have rounded-md (6-8px) for a sharp, technical look—NOT overly rounded.

surfaces: Grid Borders: Expose the skeleton. Give cards 1px solid borders using the border color.
Glassmorphism: Use ONLY for the sticky top navigation (bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-border). DO NOT use transparent backgrounds without blur.
Hover states: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle shadow glow based on accent color.
textures: Add a subtle grid texture to the main background: linear-gradient(rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px) with background-size: 30px 30px.

components.gauge: A large half-circle (180deg) SVG gauge or Recharts PieChart (startAngle 180, endAngle 0) to display the Risk Percentage. Fill color dynamically changes based on risk level.
components.buttons: Primary buttons should have a neon tech vibe: sharp edges, cyan border, transparent background, cyan text, and solid cyan background on hover with black text.
components.textarea: Dark, monospaced textarea with no outline, just a cyan ring on focus. Should feel like a terminal input.

rules: Use micro-interactions for feedback: subtle glows on hover, crisp transitions.
Entrance animations: Staggered fade-up for stats cards and list items.
Gauge Animation: The risk gauge must animate from 0 to the calculated score smoothly.
Ensure text contrast ratios meet WCAG AA.
All interactive elements MUST have focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan-500.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, key output text).

media.icons: Use lucide-react. Prefer ShieldAlert, Target, ShieldCheck, Activity, Link, Server, History.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use Recharts for any history trends if needed, but primarily use standard SVG or Shadcn/Radix components for the circular gauge. No heavy 3D required for this precise, data-heavy tool.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Google Fonts in public/index.html or import them in index.css: IBM Plex Sans and JetBrains Mono.

2. Modify tailwind.config.js to include custom colors inside the extend block: colors: { cyber: { bg: '#050A14', card: '#0A1120' }, risk: { critical: '#FF3366', high: '#FF9900', medium: '#FFD700', low: '#00E5FF', safe: '#00E676' } }.
3. Set the global body background to the dark navy cyber bg and text to light gray/white.
4. Force the application to render in Dark Mode (add 'dark' class to html/body or use standard Shadcn dark mode setups).
5. Use Shadcn components for the Select (Sample Loader), Textarea (Input), Table (History), and Cards.
6. Build a custom SVG-based Circular Gauge for the 'Phishing Risk Percentage' that maps the score (0-100) to an arc, color-coded by the risk level.
7. Implement LocalStorage for the 'Analysis History Table' and the Stats Dashboard. When the user analyzes a text, save the result.

8. Mock the AI reasoning / URL analysis in the code. Have a function that takes the input text, finds 'http' or keywords (urgent, password, bank), and returns a mocked structured JSON with Risk Score, Level, Verdict, Indicators, and AI Reasoning.
9. Add the grid pattern background to the root layout.
10. Ensure the entire layout is fully responsive, stacking cleanly on mobile.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glowing borders.
DO NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions to specific properties to avoid breaking transforms.
DO NOT center align the app container. Respect optical alignment and reading flow.
Always use modern button styles, specifically tactical/sharp tech styles for this dashboard.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons. Use lucide-react icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus rings).
Use generous spacing (p-6, p-8) inside cards to prevent cramped layouts.
Use sonner for toasts and notifications.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
